snippet.title: Death Squared: Co-op Puzzle Gameplay with ROBOTS!
snippet.description:
Co-op games are at their best when they demand a shared logic. Death Squared is challenging, but in a way that can be understood by anyone from a hardened puzzle fan to kids and grandparents.
